rules.attempt_001: Initial complete execution attempt across all 12 runs.
rules.attempt_002_conditions: Attempt 002 is permitted ONLY IF Attempt 001 fails to complete all twelve runs and the Operator formally classifies the failure under [L3] as a platform/resource failure (e.g., host OOM, platform timeout, unexpected container termination). Any deterministic pre-scientific or code failure remains non-retryable without a new execution-repair instance.
rules.attempt_002_scope: Attempt 002 MUST be a complete full restart of all 12 runs from the beginning under identical governing hashes and environment.
rules.governing_run: The first complete attempt is governing.
rules.isolation_and_combination: Partial results from different attempts are NEVER combined or spliced together. Every attempt begins in an absent namespace.
rules.post_run_binding: Kaggle API and explicit-version dataset downloads occur after execution. Transient external API/download failure leaves PENDING_EXTERNAL_BINDING and may be retried without consuming or rerunning a scientific attempt. A scientific verdict is prohibited until binding succeeds.
rules.post_run_identity_mismatch: After successful version enumeration, zero dataset versions matching the runtime canonical listing, a non-complete kernel, or a conclusive output/hash mismatch yields EXECUTION_IDENTITY_UNBOUND. It does not automatically authorize a scientific retry.
rules.runner_preflight: Failure before the runner starts the execute-all driver process is operational and does not consume a scientific attempt. Once execute-all starts, the attempt is consumed under this policy.
rules.terminal_failure_disposition: If Attempt 002 also fails to complete all 12 runs, the disposition is EXECUTION_BLOCKED_RESOURCE.
